The '''Basic Climbing Gear''' set was a product of the [[Pretormin Environmental/Legends|Pretormin Environmental]] company which included a series of tools designed to aid users in climbing in wilderness areas. It included spooled lengths of cable with an attachment to secure the line and four quick-adhesion pads capable of attaching to most surfaces. The set cost 50 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Basic Climbing Gear was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
